fields.title: Unleash On Removal
fields.description: If true, all entities leashed to this entity are automatically unleashed when this component is removed. Defaults to true.

generated_doNotEdit.title: Leashable To
generated_doNotEdit.description: Allows players to leash entities to this entity, retrieve entities already leashed to it, or free them using shears. For the last interaction to work, the leashed entities must have "can_be_cut" set to true in their "minecraft:leashable" component.
